digest.component_or_area: Documentation and source comment quality across repository
propositions: Repository documentation and comments must conform to formal prose standards prohibiting em dashes, en dashes, semicolons, and clause-connecting colons while requiring complete sentences, precise verbs, and no filler adjectives.

Three shards (durable records, external documentation, developer comments) require separate exploration with defined precedence rules so each surface has one owner, followed by cross-shard challenge filtering for evidence quality, factual accuracy, placement, and prose conformance.

Generated artifacts including configuration reference, ADR index, CLI reference, MCP reference, and synchronized templates require canonical source ownership, drift checking, and regeneration contracts before changes are authorized.

Fifty foundational and priority-one remediation items address false guidance (P0), audience defects and maintainability (P1), and bounded research prerequisites (P2) across client documentation, internal records, comments, templates, and operator runbooks.

Foundation work (F01 policy, F06 navigation, F07 index validation) completed with disposition; F08+ batch implementation delegated to REB-3501 epic; F02, F03, F04 rejected; F05 revised to generator-local descriptors instead of central registry.
Audit completed without project file changes; ticket close authorized by operator ruling that documentation standards work superseded by epic REB-3501.
